title: Report export without shell
author: benchmark
note: Safe: argument list (no shell), input validated, auth required.

changed_files.diff:
+import re
+import subprocess
+from flask import request, abort
+
+SAFE_NAME = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$")
+
+@app.route("/reports/export")
+@login_required
+def export_report():
+    name = request.args.get("name", "")
+    if not SAFE_NAME.match(name):
+        abort(400)
+    subprocess.run(["tar", "-czf", "/tmp/export.tgz", f"/data/reports/{name}"], check=True)
+    return "ok"
